title: Paired 90-session JSON versus verified-TOON comprehension confirmation
description: Five exact-answer task families, two semantically identical input representations, three frozen model/reasoning configurations, and three repetitions per cell. Model output remains JSON in both arms.

frozen_config.output_format: JSON constrained by a per-task schema in both input arms
frozen_config.retry_policy: no session reruns, replacements, or exclusions

design.unit: one fresh ephemeral Codex session answering one task from one representation
design.pair: same task, model/reasoning configuration, and replicate under compact JSON and canonical TOON
design.treatment: only the context representation and its honest format label differ
design.semantic_control: runner decodes canonical TOON and verifies equality with the ordered JSON data model before any session
design.randomization: all 90 cells shuffled once with seed 340260805 before concurrent execution
design.hidden_scoring: exact answer stored in the task manifest and omitted from the prompt
design.session_accounting: Codex input, cached input, output, reasoning output, total tokens, elapsed time, command events, parser status, and exact correctness
design.known_stage_a_result: Iteration 033 saved 4.5682% cl100k_base and 4.5673% o200k_base across the broad corpus and failed its frozen 5% gate. These Stage B contexts are the record-heavy shapes where TOON was verified to help.
design.deviation_from_stage_b_outline: The outline in AGENT_DATA_PROTOCOL_033 proposed three independently frozen model IDs. The configured Codex environment exposes two benchmarked IDs, gpt-5.6-sol and gpt-5.6-terra, so iteration 034 freezes three model/reasoning configurations instead: sol low, sol medium, and terra medium. This limitation is declared before task output and blocks a three-model generality claim.

conditions.execution_integrity: 90 unique fresh threads; zero timeout, nonzero return, agent error, or tool-command event
conditions.accuracy_noninferior: TOON exact successes are no more than two below JSON overall and no more than one below JSON in any of the three agent configurations
conditions.parse_noninferior: TOON JSON-response parse successes are at least JSON parse successes
conditions.input_tokens_lower: summed TOON-arm Codex input tokens are strictly below summed JSON-arm input tokens
conditions.total_tokens_lower: summed TOON-arm input plus output tokens are strictly below summed JSON-arm total tokens

interpretation.all_five_pass: Evidence that verified TOON input is non-inferior and cheaper for these record-heavy agent tasks under the frozen configurations; not a universal format or language win.
interpretation.any_fail: Preserve the failure, keep JSON as the contract/default fallback, and do not tune prompts, contexts, schemas, profile, models, or margins on these sessions.
interpretation.prohibited_claim: This experiment does not compare Parley source code with Python or Rust and cannot establish that Parley is the best general-purpose language.
